text:
Claire (partnerships): FYI: Marketplace ops are rotating the webhook signer tomorrow 06:00 UTC. There's a change in the signature envelope that will break SDKs < v2.4 if we don't handle it. Can SDK + infra triage? :wave:
Sam (sdk): On it. Quick Q — do we have the exact header change? If it's just formatting we can add fallback parsing in a patch (v2.4.1) and ship tonight.
Raj (infra): Old header pattern we've been sending: `X-Marketplace-Signature: sha256=BASE64SIG`
Raj (infra): New pattern they'll emit: `X-Marketplace-Signature: signed-t=1618291200;alg=sha256;sig=HEX_SIG`
Sam (sdk): OK that explains it. We'll implement verifier that accepts both formats for a transition window. Plan: fallback parser + feature flag to disable old-format acceptance. Patch target: v2.4.1.
Lina (marketplace): We can keep dual-signing on our side for 7 days, plus publish a banner on the Marketplace console. Recommend partners get 14 days' notice though — will that work?
Sam (sdk): Dual-accept for 14 days is safer. We'll default to accept both formats for 14 days, then flip the opt-in flag off in 7 days, then remove code in a minor later. Need infra to ensure Dedicated/Private deploys can toggle fallback via env.
Raj (infra): We can expose `MARKETPLACE_SIG_FALLBACK=true` in Dedicated and Private. Need a config rollout window: staging -> canary -> prod. @deploy-bot can you run a canary after SDK tests pass?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Received request — scheduling canary for MARKETPLACE_SIG_FALLBACK on staging in 5m. Will report status. :robot_face:
Sam (sdk): Example compatibility snippet for partners: `curl -H "X-Marketplace-Signature: sha256=BASE64SIG" https://api.redwood.com/webhook` and new: `curl -H "X-Marketplace-Signature: signed-t=1618291200;alg=sha256;sig=HEX_SIG" https://api.redwood.com/webhook`. We'll add this to the changelog and migration notes.
Claire (partnerships): Who will draft the partner email and Marketplace banner copy? Also need a joint announcement cadence for partners that have deeper integrations (SI & HW partners).
Lina (marketplace): I'll draft the partner email + console banner. Suggest: 1) Immediate banner 2) Email 48 hours before rotation 3) Post-rotation follow-up with logs/samples for partners who hit failures. I'll loop in partner success.
Sam (sdk): I will open a PR with the fallback parser, tests, and docs. ETA: PR by EOD, ship v2.4.1 canary in morning after infra canary passes.
Raj (infra): After deploy-bot canary completes, I'll schedule Dedicated/Private config rollout. We'll keep the fallback flag enabled for 14 days, then coordinate removal. Also will add a metric `webhook.signature.fallback_used` so we can measure how many partners rely on old format.
Claire (partnerships): Perfect. Can someone own partner outreach? @Lina please + cc Partnerships. I'll assemble a short partner FAQ to attach. :thumbsup:
Lina (marketplace): On it. I'll share drafts in #partnerships-docs later today.
Sam (sdk): Noted — I'll include migration code sample in multiple languages (py/node/go) in the PR.
Claire (partnerships): Thanks team. Quick checklist: QA canary -> SDK PR -> infra canary -> partner banner/email -> rotation -> post-rotation follow-up + metrics review. Will reconvene if fallback metrics > 2% after 48h.
Raj (infra): Roger.
Sam (sdk): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/421 (canary builds attached).
Claire (partnerships): Excellent — closing loop here but keep thread updated if anything slips.
